d.ko: A mystery visual novel where horror meets occult comedy. Follow Kugayama Shiori, a ghost who casually dies over and over as she searches for her cause of death and the regrets that bind her to this world. Her investigation will eventually lead to a single incident—and the truth behind her demise.

d.zh: 本作是一款以灵异喜剧为主轴的恐怖悬疑视觉小说。讲述了以轻率的态度不断重复自杀的幽灵久我山栞，追寻自己的死因与未了执念的故事。而在最终揭开的那起事件中，隐藏着她死亡的真相——
